summary: v21/v18 correctly close the complete Context key, E-to-A single-root binding and opaque-handle identity. But v18 conflicts with the v21 Bootstrap/E/C writer matrix and lacks an E publication path, supplies only a QualityPass ref rather than trusted PASS-byte observation, and does not make lock ownership an unavoidable registry mutation capability. The component-address base is also ambiguous.
commands: read-only review of v19/v20 and retained M6 replay inventory contracts

limitations: No training, archival replay, budget consumption, real PIT certification, or final-OOS access.

blockers: Restore one exact Bootstrap/E/C writer and durable publisher path consistent with v21, including actual identity/ACL checks.
Make QualityPass-to-Bootstrap verification consume observed trusted bytes and a parsed PASS record, not only a typed ref.
Make a verified held lock capability mandatory for R/V/terminal mutation and specify its concurrency/crash lifecycle.
Define the anchor basis and no-follow resolver contract for every root/registry-relative component list.
Re-run independent R3 design review before test design or implementation.
